advisory_qualification.reason: Fresh replay rejected an inadmissible Python installation artifact before Official evaluation.

causal_disposition.reason: The submitted program did not normalize Git safe.directory for the fresh Official checkout. setuptools_scm failed on dubious ownership before Pyright. This independently repeats the basxconnect and clarity failure mechanism.
